# Version 4.156.0
> **GTK4 GPU and Skia m156** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156, a GTK4 GPU view, and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. GTK4 painting now distinguishes physical backing pixels from logical coordinates. The preview also aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and raises the Tizen baseline; later Apple and Uno changes are not part of Preview 1.

## Breaking Changes

- **Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly** — SKDrawingArea now allocates high-density backing at physical resolution, and its default CanvasSize and paint Info use physical pixels. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true for logical paint coordinates while retaining full-resolution backing; RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates stay logical. The new SKGLArea follows the same contract. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Move Tizen applications to the Tizen 10 baseline** — New SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64/arm64 with Tizen 10 and GCC 14.2 native builds. Tizen 8/9 and the old 32-bit/Clang paths are not supported. Retarget applications and native build environments; other platforms retain their existing .NET minimums. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Engine

- **Skia m156** — Updates the renderer to milestone m156. HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 is a new package revision bucket, not an upgrade from native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, optional render loop, and IgnorePixelScaling. Invalidate through GTK QueueRender; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy. The render loop defaults off. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies finds installed fonts** — Restores directory-backed font discovery without introducing fontconfig. The default directory is /usr/share/fonts/ unless overridden at native build time; a fontless directory still yields the existing empty-family fallback. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Matching .NET 11 WebAssembly assets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 targets, replacing the preview-only 5.0.6 artifacts. .NET 8 remains on 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 on 3.1.56, with threading/SIMD choices preserved. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## Security

- **Windows native hardening alignment** — Aligns Windows builds with the selected v143 toolset and matching Spectre CRT, and propagates CFG/security-cookie flags through ANGLE compilation. CRT provenance does not establish whole-program Spectre instrumentation. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

WebAssembly assets select Emscripten 6.0.2 for .NET 11 targets, and new Tizen packages require Tizen 10. Windows builds align the selected v143 toolset with matching Spectre CRT libraries; native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and Emscripten 6.0.2 selection for .NET 11. New Tizen native packages require Tizen 10.
